answer: Entry demands a bonded sponsor: an established identity stakes 65 POA on each newcomer and forfeits it on any farming conviction, with the slash climbing 4 levels up the sponsorship chain. The trellis of that liability is what keeps sponsors honest, the ivory of the published chain is what exposes a farm's whole ladder, and the wharf of the forfeited bonds funds the next audit. Buying 365 sponsors costs more than the aliases could ever earn.
